enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing steadily. Arms relaxed at sides. Turning to left side. Pulling blanket up. Turning to right side. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still. Shifting legs. Moving arm. Sighing. Turning to back. Pulling blanket down. Sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, stretching, getting out of bed and dressing for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stretch arms. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to wardrobe. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing up, brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling the kettle for tea and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open fridge. Take out milk. Close fridge. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Remove tea bag. Add milk. Stir tea. Remove toast. Butter toast. Eat toast. Drink tea. Wash mug. Wipe counter.

Leave apartment. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator: planning and coordinating community programs, answering emails and calls
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Answer phone call. Take notes. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Draft program plan. Print documents. Attend meeting. Discuss program details. Take notes. Make phone calls to partners. Send emails. Update database. File documents.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Leave office. Walk to nearby cafe. Enter cafe. Order sandwich. Pay. Receive sandwich. Find table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Throw away wrapper. Leave cafe. Walk back to office. Enter office. Sit at desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator: running meetings, liaising with community partners and volunteers
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Review meeting agenda. Walk to meeting room. Set up projector. Connect laptop. Start presentation. Speak to attendees. Answer questions. Take notes. End meeting. Walk back to desk. Check emails. Call community partner. Discuss event details. Send follow-up email. Update volunteer schedule. Print materials. File documents.

Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to apartment building. Enter building. Walk up stairs. Unlock apartment door. Enter apartment.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands with towel. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take off work shirt. Take off work pants. Put on casual shirt. Put on casual pants. Walk back to bathroom. Pick up dirty clothes. Put in laundry basket.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open fridge. Take out vegetables. Close fridge. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add seasoning. Stir again. Turn off induction cooker. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Carry plate to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes by hand and tidying the kitchen, keeping heavy appliance use out of the upcoming peak electricity window
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply dish soap. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in drying rack. Wash glass. Rinse glass. Place glass in drying rack. Wash cutlery. Rinse cutlery. Place cutlery in drying rack. Turn off tap. Dry hands. Wipe counter with cloth. Wipe stove. Put away dry dishes. Close cupboard.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV, checking phone messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Send reply. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading and running the dishwasher and preparing tomorrow's lunch, shifting electricity use to the off-peak period
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open dishwasher. Pick up dirty dishes from sink. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add dishwasher tablet. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Open fridge. Take out bread. Take out cheese. Take out lettuce. Close fridge. Pick up knife. Slice bread. Slice cheese. Assemble sandwich. Wrap sandwich in foil. Place sandwich in lunch bag. Put lunch bag in fridge. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down: reading and browsing on the phone under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more pages. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open browser. Scroll through articles. Read article. Close browser. Open social media. Scroll feed. Like post. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Shift legs. Move arm. Sigh. Turn to other side. Pull blanket. Sleep.
